drafted_from: tool:run-sql-in-my-database's row shape and the old sales-contract records door (5f1efcaee, sales-contract-actions.mjs, removed); sample runs answered on the Mac with tool:sales-contracts
start_here: Say to your AI: "Save my Spring coaching sales contract in my pursuit database and show me my last five contracts", with {"action":"save","database":"shop_for_who_runs_it","contract":{"name":"Spring coaching","primitives":[]}} and then {"action":"list","database":"shop_for_who_runs_it","limit":5}. It runs tool:sales-contracts and answers the saved contract and the page of contracts, each with its times.
no_lists_because: The contracts are rows of the sales_contracts table in the pursuit database the person names (the tool makes that table on first use), not rows of a list, so there is no list for a person to keep or pour into.
instructions: Name the pursuit database that sells the contract, for example shop_for_who_runs_it; its connection is held in the vault under that name with -connection.
To save a new contract, call tool:sales-contracts with action save and a contract that has a name; leave contract_id out.
To change a saved contract, call save again with its contract_id; its first creation time and its share id stay.
To read one, call read with its contract_id; to see the newest contracts, call list with limit, and then with the next cursor it answered for the next page.
A removed contract is not read and is not revived by a save; save its terms as a new contract instead.
